checkpoint_revision_note: These are model/checkpoint repositories, distinct from dataset revisions below.

selection.ranking: Ascending SHA256 of UTF8(decimal_seed + verticalbar + source_key + verticalbar + source_id). No answer-based ranking.
selection.wikitext_source_id: Zero-based target Parquet row index as canonical decimal string.
selection.wikitext_eligibility: Trimmed nonempty row; not a heading matching ^\s*=+.*=+\s*$; at least160 Python str.split whitespace words. Row is the paragraph unit; no joining across rows.
selection.wikitext_prompt: Exactly first160 whitespace words joined by one ASCII space, followed by LF. No detokenization, instruction or chat template. Original full row retained.
selection.arc_source_id: Publisher id string; duplicate ids are an integrity failure, not a reason to resample.
selection.arc_eligibility: Question stem at least5 whitespace words; exactly4 nonempty choices with4 distinct nonempty labels; rendered full stem+choices at most96 whitespace words. No answerKey read for eligibility/ranking.
selection.arc_prompt: question.strip() + LF + each choice in source order as label.strip()+dot+space+text.strip(), LF-separated, final LF. No answer/correct label/cue appended.
selection.item_order: WikiText rank00..07, then ARC rank00..07. Source identity selected only by frozen ranking. No output- or tokenizer-driven replacement.
selection.insufficient_eligible: Fail and retain failure; do not relax rules or resample silently.

workload_contract.purpose: Independent same-format placement/numerical validation with fresh project workloads; not a new quantization method.
workload_contract.language_model_quality: LM tokenizer is the existing GGUF tokenizer, add_special=true. First128 tokens, score positions1..127, no chat template; token counts are recorded after selection, not selection criteria.
workload_contract.generation: 16 fixed prompt files; roughly128 prefill and16 decode tokens per item. Preserve complete ARC question/options; runner must document any differing token budget.
workload_contract.arc_answers: Separate answers/arc_answers.json, never included in prompt files. Free generation16/32tokens is not benchmark accuracy.
workload_contract.placement: Existing frozen Granite4 plan and numeric contract unchanged; no placement/weight calibration fit after new payload.
workload_contract.statistical_scope: Eight length-eligible examples per source, not a representative full benchmark; no model-pretraining contamination claim.

preprotocol_exposure.metadata_viewer_erratum: During publisher metadata verification, HF landing pages auto-displayed a few WikiText103raw train and ARC-Challenge train examples. Those are not the target WikiText2test/ARCvalidation payloads and do not enter eligibility or ranking. No target viewer preview is used.
